limitations: Five cases selected because they failed historically; single repeat per case. No population accuracy or pass-cubed inference.
Claude live results and Codex historical proposals differ in model and execution context; no attribution solely to wording.
No merging with twenty historical passing cases to claim a new full-suite pass rate.

Ordinary successful requests exercise the allowed path and detector/writer integration, not adversarial rejection, target-manipulation rejection, privilege escalation resistance, or prompt-injection robustness.
No credit or timeout exhaustion was exercised, so no empirical proof of hard limit enforcement or invoice ceiling.
Cost estimates are separate agent/detector usage reconciliations, not provider invoices or all workflow spending.
